probeMethod: curl -s -o <file> -w 'http_code / content_type / size_download' -m 25 -A 'Mozilla/5.0', then Pillow open for dims/mode/corner alpha. No URL in this file was written from memory; every row was fetched and measured.
aspectRatioNote: A One Piece card is 63x88mm = 0.716. The framed content of the in-use asset measures 380x610 = 0.621, which is the shape of the sealed packet, not the card. That ratio mismatch is the numeric fingerprint of the wrong subject.

candidates.sourceChain: WebSearch surfaced the TCGplayer product page for 'Monkey.D.Luffy (010) (Dodgers x ONE PIECE)' -> product id 641620 -> CDN object probed directly. The product page itself is JS-rendered and returned no og:image to WebFetch, so the CDN object was probed and measured instead of parsed out of HTML.
candidates.workRequired: Not native rounded RGBA. It is an RGB JPEG on a white background with square corners, so the pipeline must run has_rounded_corners() -> apply_rounded_corners() before normalize_card_canvas(). 625x873 downscales to 429x600 (factor 0.686), so no upscaling is involved.
candidates.residualRisk: Third-party marketplace scan rather than a publisher asset; white background must be keyed out rather than assumed transparent. Needs one human look after normalization, which is exactly the review step the in-use asset never got.

candidates.note: Same artwork, but 313x437 is below the 429x600 canvas, so using it would mean upscaling.

steps: Fetch the CDN object (625x873 RGB JPEG).
Key out the white background, then apply_rounded_corners() - the file has square corners, unlike every SNK/Kado source the resolver normally sees.
normalize_card_canvas() to 429x600 RGBA and confirm cornerAlphaMax <= CORNER_ALPHA_MAX.
Set semanticMatchStatus to a reviewed value, not metadata_exact_unreviewed, after a human compares the result against https://en.onepiece-cardgame.com/images/cardlist/card/EB02-010_p2.png.
Retire the sealed-pack asset sha 398cebb1de0c93b47f02025816e49cfa29f88a42fba5eba047cf854f5276c17c for this variant.
recommendation.notPerformedHere: This is a read-only audit. Nothing was written to data/public/market-assets, apps/web/public/market-assets, or the database. The candidate is recorded for the mainline to execute.
